verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting supports routing notifications to multiple systems (Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie per grafana-gh-7) and Grafana Cloud offers AI-agent connectivity via a Cloud/self-hosted MCP server and automated investigation tooling (grafana-docs-7, grafana-docs-33), suggesting a pathway from alerts to automated remediation/agents. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a generic webhook contact-point type or a direct 'alert → webhook → agent' remediation workflow. Missing for 10: explicit webhook contact-point documentation, a documented example of alerts triggering automated remediation actions or agent invocation via webhook, and independent confirmation of this specific workflow.
